semantic_claims.label: paper topic and method
semantic_claims.summary: The source paper 'Toward Foundation Detection Models via Example-Based Grounding in EM-DETR' proposes a multi-source lesion detector using a two-stage teacher/student plan and modified EM-DETR for example-driven, cross-modality grounding.

semantic_claims.label: reported performance gains
semantic_claims.summary: The abstract record claims ~1 point image-level AUC gain over prior leading CXR results and ~2-3 mAP50 points over single-source EM-DETR on CXR and mammography.

semantic_claims.label: evidence gaps and limitations
semantic_claims.summary: Only the arXiv abstract was read; full text, specific dataset names, and the reference list are missing, so numeric gains and method details remain unverified candidates.

semantic_claims.label: tool constraints
semantic_claims.summary: WebFetch is limited to the first ~100,000 characters of a page and cannot read later slices or re-fetch different ranges, requiring work from available content.
